intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently test the assigned karst surface subsurface drainage concept in one complex photorealistic environmental scene, using the supplied portrait only as a general adult appearance reference while keeping the landform and connected water-routing evidence primary and unobstructed.

Create one photorealistic 35 mm deep-focus environmental photograph from a low ridge after clearing monsoon rain. The principal subject is a broad karst plateau whose surface water visibly drains underground and returns as a spring. Show pale exposed limestone etched by solution grooves, a closed bowl-shaped depression collecting runoff, and a continuous rain-fed stream descending across the basin into a clearly visible swallow opening; on the lower slope, blue-green water must visibly issue from a separate dark limestone cave mouth as a vigorous resurgence pool. Place one unmistakably adult documentary landscape photographer with the reference portrait's general facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair, and natural facial texture in the lower-left quarter, clearly visible yet no larger than one fifth of the frame, placing two small red flow markers beside the exact point where a rain-fed stream sinks into a limestone opening. Keep every drainage feature unobstructed and legible together. Use wet charcoal rock, moss green, turquoise water, distant mist, foreground runoff, oblique late-afternoon sunlight, realistic scale, continuous terrain, and crisp geological depth.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
